verdict.rationale: Issuing scoped API credentials is a fair question for a payments and risk SaaS platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack covers API credential creation, roles, permission scopes, or least-privilege keys. The MCP server and webhook items are separate capabilities and do not show scoped credentials for an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
